title: A 23-Point Counterexample to a Modified Half-Frequency Conjecture for Union–Intersection Systems
summary: We consider a variant of Vince's half-frequency conjecture for union-intersection systems in which an entire system must be nontrivial, while a system is declared trivial only when all its blocks are singletons or when its only block is the whole ground set; every such trivial system is stipulated to be irreducible. For nontrivial systems, irreducibility retains Vince's two-part partition criterion, and complete irreducibility is tested on the system and all subsystems induced by actual blocks.
